results.name: Ancient Horse Chariot (Mauryan era)
results.description:
A 3d model of a horse chariot, It is low-poly, Rigged and Animated. (Has a basic gallop animation, I might add the other ones later) It has 2 armatures and has 3 Different meshes for one chariot and two horses. The design and the aesthetic of this 3d model was heavily inspired by the ancient chariots which were extensively used during the 3rd centure BC, during the Mauryan Empire.

The 3d model as a whole has around 12K vertices and 24K triangles (Around 5K vertices/9K tris for each horse).
The animation is a looping galloping animation which lasts for exactly 12 frames or 0.5 seconds at a standard 24 FPS.
